column1: # decision-phrasings.tsv -- the closed list of phrasings that ask someone to
# decide, or address a person rather than the coordinator. Read only through
# scripts/phrasing-lib.sh (phrase_match), by the scripts that show text to a
# person or read a worker's report. It is a backstop: a decision shown to a
# person comes only from an escalated decision entry, and rewording evades any
#   kind     decision   the text asks someone to decide
#            addressed  the text asks a person, or the reader, to decide or act
#            both       both at once, such as the imperative "please decide";
#                       one row, so the two kinds can't drift apart
#   pattern  an extended regular expression, matched case-insensitively by
#            grep -E. No back-references. Word edges are spelled
#            aren't taken by BSD grep, and phrasing-lib.sh refuses them.
